items.summary: In the User View (UserView.tsx), add a dark rounded card box above the Single Comment Generator section that contains: a 'Top-Down Shooter' title (styled in cyan/teal gradient text), instruction text ('Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Click to shoot. Survive as long as you can!'), and a 'Start Game' button. The card should use the existing dark glass-card style consistent with the app's dark space theme. Clicking 'Start Game' should launch the existing TopDownShooter canvas game inside or below the card.
